translations.en.sahih: The Most Merciful
translations.en.pickthall: The Beneficent
translations.en.yusufali: (Allah) Most Gracious!
translations.id.indonesian: (Tuhan) Yang Maha Pemurah,

translations.en.sahih: Taught the Qur'an,
translations.en.pickthall: Hath made known the Qur'an.
translations.en.yusufali: It is He Who has taught the Qur'an.
translations.id.indonesian: Yang telah mengajarkan al Quran.

translations.en.sahih: Created man,
translations.en.pickthall: He hath created man.
translations.en.yusufali: He has created man:
translations.id.indonesian: Dia menciptakan manusia.

translations.en.sahih: [And] taught him eloquence.
translations.en.pickthall: He hath taught him utterance.
translations.en.yusufali: He has taught him speech (and intelligence).
translations.id.indonesian: Mengajarnya pandai berbicara.

translations.en.sahih: The sun and the moon [move] by precise calculation,
translations.en.pickthall: The sun and the moon are made punctual.
translations.en.yusufali: The sun and the moon follow courses (exactly) computed;
translations.id.indonesian: Matahari dan bulan (beredar) menurut perhitungan.

translations.en.sahih: And the stars and trees prostrate.
translations.en.pickthall: The stars and the trees prostrate.
translations.en.yusufali: And the herbs and the trees - both (alike) prostrate in adoration.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan tumbuh-tumbuhan dan pohon-pohonan kedua-duanya tunduk kepada-Nya.

translations.en.sahih: And the heaven He raised and imposed the balance
translations.en.pickthall: And the sky He hath uplifted; and He hath set the measure,
translations.en.yusufali: And the Firmament has He raised high, and He has set up the Balance (of Justice),
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Allah telah meninggikan langit dan Dia meletakkan neraca (keadilan).

translations.en.sahih: That you not transgress within the balance.
translations.en.pickthall: That ye exceed not the measure,
translations.en.yusufali: In order that ye may not transgress (due) balance.
translations.id.indonesian: Supaya kamu jangan melampaui batas tentang neraca itu.

arabic: وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلْوَزْنَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَلَا تُخْسِرُوا۟ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
transliteration: Wa aqeemul wazna bilqisti wa laa tukhsirul meezaan

translations.en.sahih: And establish weight in justice and do not make deficient the balance.
translations.en.pickthall: But observe the measure strictly, nor fall short thereof.
translations.en.yusufali: So establish weight with justice and fall not short in the balance.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan tegakkanlah timbangan itu dengan adil dan janganlah kamu mengurangi neraca itu.

translations.en.sahih: And the earth He laid [out] for the creatures.
translations.en.pickthall: And the earth hath He appointed for (His) creatures,
translations.en.yusufali: It is He Who has spread out the earth for (His) creatures:
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Allah telah meratakan bumi untuk makhluk(Nya).

transliteration: Feehaa faakihatunw wan nakhlu zaatul akmaam

translations.en.sahih: Therein is fruit and palm trees having sheaths [of dates]
translations.en.pickthall: Wherein are fruit and sheathed palm-trees,
translations.en.yusufali: Therein is fruit and date-palms, producing spathes (enclosing dates);
translations.id.indonesian: Di bumi itu ada buah-buahan dan pohon kurma yang mempunyai kelopak mayang.

translations.en.sahih: And grain having husks and scented plants.
translations.en.pickthall: Husked grain and scented herb.
translations.en.yusufali: Also corn, with (its) leaves and stalk for fodder, and sweet-smelling plants.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan biji-bijian yang berkulit dan bunga-bunga yang harum baunya.

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.en.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
translations.en.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
translations.id.indonesian: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

translations.en.sahih: He created man from clay like [that of] pottery.
translations.en.pickthall: He created man of clay like the potter's,
translations.en.yusufali: He created man from sounding clay like unto pottery,
translations.id.indonesian: Dia menciptakan manusia dari tanah kering seperti tembikar,

arabic: وَخَلَقَ ٱلْجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجٍۢ مِّن نَّارٍۢ
transliteration: Wa khalaqal jaaan mim maarijim min naar

translations.en.sahih: And He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire.
translations.en.pickthall: And the jinn did He create of smokeless fire.
translations.en.yusufali: And He created Jinns from fire free of smoke:
translations.id.indonesian: dan Dia menciptakan jin dari nyala api.

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.en.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
translations.en.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
translations.id.indonesian: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

translations.en.sahih: [He is] Lord of the two sunrises and Lord of the two sunsets.
translations.en.pickthall: Lord of the two Easts, and Lord of the two Wests!
translations.en.yusufali: (He is) Lord of the two Easts and Lord of the two Wests:
translations.id.indonesian: Tuhan yang memelihara kedua tempat terbit matahari dan Tuhan yang memelihara kedua tempat terbenamnya

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.en.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
translations.en.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
translations.id.indonesian: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

translations.en.sahih: He released the two seas, meeting [side by side];
translations.en.pickthall: He hath loosed the two seas. They meet.
translations.en.yusufali: He has let free the two bodies of flowing water, meeting together:
translations.id.indonesian: Dia membiarkan dua lautan mengalir yang keduanya kemudian bertemu,

translations.en.sahih: Between them is a barrier [so] neither of them transgresses.
translations.en.pickthall: There is a barrier between them. They encroach not (one upon the other).
translations.en.yusufali: Between them is a Barrier which they do not transgress:
translations.id.indonesian: antara keduanya ada batas yang tidak dilampaui masing-masing.

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.en.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
translations.en.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
translations.id.indonesian: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

transliteration: Yakhruju minhumal lu 'lu u wal marjaanu

translations.en.sahih: From both of them emerge pearl and coral.
translations.en.pickthall: There cometh forth from both of them the pearl and coral-stone.
translations.en.yusufali: Out of them come Pearls and Coral:
translations.id.indonesian: Dari keduanya keluar mutiara dan marjan.

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.en.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
translations.en.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
translations.id.indonesian: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

arabic: وَلَهُ ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْمُنشَـَٔاتُ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ كَٱلْأَعْلَٰمِ
transliteration: Wa lahul jawaaril mun sha'aatu fil bahri kal a'laam

translations.en.sahih: And to Him belong the ships [with sails] elevated in the sea like mountains.
translations.en.pickthall: His are the ships displayed upon the sea, like banners.
translations.en.yusufali: And His are the Ships sailing smoothly through the seas, lofty as mountains:
translations.id.indonesian: Dan kepunyaan-Nya lah bahtera-bahtera yang tinggi layarnya di lautan laksana gunung-gunung.

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.en.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
translations.en.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
translations.id.indonesian: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

translations.en.sahih: Everyone upon the earth will perish,
translations.en.pickthall: Everyone that is thereon will pass away;
translations.en.yusufali: All that is on earth will perish:
translations.id.indonesian: Semua yang ada di bumi itu akan binasa.

arabic: وَيَبْقَىٰ وَجْهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو ٱلْجَلَٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
transliteration: Wa yabqaa wajhu rabbika zul jalaali wal ikraam

translations.en.sahih: And there will remain the Face of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.
translations.en.pickthall: There remaineth but the Countenance of thy Lord of Might and Glory.
translations.en.yusufali: But will abide (for ever) the Face of thy Lord,- full of Majesty, Bounty and Honour.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan tetap kekal Dzat Tuhanmu yang mempunyai kebesaran dan kemuliaan.

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.en.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
translations.en.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
translations.id.indonesian: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

arabic: يَسْـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِى شَأْنٍۢ
transliteration: Yas'aluhoo man fissamaawaati walard; kulla ywmin huwa fee shaan

translations.en.sahih: Whoever is within the heavens and earth asks Him; every day He is bringing about a matter.
translations.en.pickthall: All that are in the heavens and the earth entreat Him. Every day He exerciseth (universal) power.
translations.en.yusufali: Of Him seeks (its need) every creature in the heavens and on earth: every day in (new) Splendour doth He (shine)!
translations.id.indonesian: Semua yang ada di langit dan bumi selalu meminta kepada-Nya. Setiap waktu Dia dalam kesibukan.

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.en.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
translations.en.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
translations.id.indonesian: Maka nikmat Rabb-mu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

translations.en.sahih: We will attend to you, O prominent beings.
translations.en.pickthall: We shall dispose of you, O ye two dependents (man and jinn).
translations.en.yusufali: Soon shall We settle your affairs, O both ye worlds!
translations.id.indonesian: Kami akan memperhatikan sepenuhnya kepadamu hai manusia dan jin.

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.en.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
translations.en.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
translations.id.indonesian: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

arabic: يَٰمَعْشَرَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَن تَنفُذُوا۟ مِنْ أَقْطَارِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنفُذُوا۟ ۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ
transliteration: Yaa ma'sharal jinni wal insi inis tata'tum an tanfuzoo min aqtaaris samaawaati wal ardi fanfuzoo; laa tanfuzoona illaa bisultaan

translations.en.sahih: O company of jinn and mankind, if you are able to pass beyond the regions of the heavens and the earth, then pass. You will not pass except by authority [from Allah].
translations.en.pickthall: O company of jinn and men, if ye have power to penetrate (all) regions of the heavens and the earth, then penetrate (them)! Ye will never penetrate them save with (Our) sanction.
translations.en.yusufali: O ye assembly of Jinns and men! If it be ye can pass beyond the zones of the heavens and the earth, pass ye! not without authority shall ye be able to pass!
translations.id.indonesian: Hai jama'ah jin dan manusia, jika kamu sanggup menembus (melintasi) penjuru langit dan bumi, maka lintasilah, kamu tidak dapat menembusnya kecuali dengan kekuatan.

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.en.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
translations.en.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
translations.id.indonesian: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

arabic: يُرْسَلُ عَلَيْكُمَا شُوَاظٌۭ مِّن نَّارٍۢ وَنُحَاسٌۭ فَلَا تَنتَصِرَانِ
transliteration: Yursalu 'alaikumaa shuwaazum min naarifiw-wa nuhaasun falaa tantasiraan

translations.en.sahih: There will be sent upon you a flame of fire and smoke, and you will not defend yourselves.
translations.en.pickthall: There will be sent, against you both, heat of fire and flash of brass, and ye will not escape.
translations.en.yusufali: On you will be sent (O ye evil ones twain!) a flame of fire (to burn) and a smoke (to choke): no defence will ye have:
translations.id.indonesian: Kepada kamu, (jin dan manusia) dilepaskan nyala api dan cairan tembaga maka kamu tidak dapat menyelamatkan diri (dari padanya).

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.en.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
translations.en.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
translations.id.indonesian: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

arabic: فَإِذَا ٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ وَرْدَةًۭ كَٱلدِّهَانِ
transliteration: Fa-izan shaqqatis samaaa'u fakaanat wardatan kaddihaan

translations.en.sahih: And when the heaven is split open and becomes rose-colored like oil -
translations.en.pickthall: And when the heaven splitteth asunder and becometh rosy like red hide -
translations.en.yusufali: When the sky is rent asunder, and it becomes red like ointment:
translations.id.indonesian: Maka apabila langit telah terbelah dan menjadi merah mawar seperti (kilapan) minyak.

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
translations.en.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny? -
translations.en.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
translations.id.indonesian: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

arabic: فَيَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّا يُسْـَٔلُ عَن ذَنۢبِهِۦٓ إِنسٌۭ وَلَا جَآنٌّۭ
transliteration: Fa-yawma'izil laa yus'alu 'an zambiheee insunw wa laa jaann

translations.en.sahih: Then on that Day none will be asked about his sin among men or jinn.
translations.en.pickthall: On that day neither man nor jinni will be questioned of his sin.
translations.en.yusufali: On that Day no question will be asked of man or Jinn as to his sin.
translations.id.indonesian: Pada waktu itu manusia dan jin tidak ditanya tentang dosanya.

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.en.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
translations.en.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
translations.id.indonesian: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

arabic: يُعْرَفُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ بِسِيمَٰهُمْ فَيُؤْخَذُ بِٱلنَّوَٰصِى وَٱلْأَقْدَامِ
transliteration: Yu'raful mujrimoona biseemaahum fa'yu'khazu binna waasi wal aqdaam

translations.en.sahih: The criminals will be known by their marks, and they will be seized by the forelocks and the feet.
translations.en.pickthall: The guilty will be known by their marks, and will be taken by the forelocks and the feet.
translations.en.yusufali: (For) the sinners will be known by their marks: and they will be seized by their forelocks and their feet.
translations.id.indonesian: Orang-orang yang berdosa dikenal dengan tanda-tandannya, lalu dipegang ubun-ubun dan kaki mereka.

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.en.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
translations.en.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
translations.id.indonesian: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

arabic: هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى يُكَذِّبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
transliteration: Haazihee jahannamul latee yukazzibu bihal mujrimoon

translations.en.sahih: This is Hell, which the criminals deny.
translations.en.pickthall: This is hell which the guilty deny.
translations.en.yusufali: This is the Hell which the Sinners deny:
translations.id.indonesian: Inilah neraka Jahannam yang didustakan oleh orang-orang berdosa.

transliteration: Yatoofoona bainahaa wa baina hameemim aan

translations.en.sahih: They will go around between it and scalding water, heated [to the utmost degree].
translations.en.pickthall: They go circling round between it and fierce, boiling water.
translations.en.yusufali: In its midst and in the midst of boiling hot water will they wander round!
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka berkeliling di antaranya dan di antara air mendidih yang memuncak panasnya.

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.en.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
translations.en.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
translations.id.indonesian: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

transliteration: Wa liman khaafa maqaama rabbihee jannataan

translations.en.sahih: But for he who has feared the position of his Lord are two gardens -
translations.en.pickthall: But for him who feareth the standing before his Lord there are two gardens.
translations.en.yusufali: But for such as fear the time when they will stand before (the Judgment Seat of) their Lord, there will be two Gardens-
translations.id.indonesian: Dan bagi orang yang takut akan saat menghadap Tuhannya ada dua surga.

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
translations.en.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
translations.en.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?-
translations.id.indonesian: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?,

translations.en.sahih: Having [spreading] branches.
translations.en.pickthall: Of spreading branches.
translations.en.yusufali: Containing all kinds (of trees and delights);-
translations.id.indonesian: kedua surga itu mempunyai pohon-pohonan dan buah-buahan.

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.en.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
translations.en.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?-
translations.id.indonesian: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

translations.en.sahih: In both of them are two springs, flowing.
translations.en.pickthall: Wherein are two fountains flowing.
translations.en.yusufali: In them (each) will be two Springs flowing (free);
translations.id.indonesian: Di dalam kedua surga itu ada dua buah mata air yang mengalir

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.en.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
translations.en.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?-
translations.id.indonesian: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

translations.en.sahih: In both of them are of every fruit, two kinds.
translations.en.pickthall: Wherein is every kind of fruit in pairs.
translations.en.yusufali: In them will be Fruits of every kind, two and two.
translations.id.indonesian: Di dalam kedua surga itu terdapat segala macam buah-buahan yang berpasangan.

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.en.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
translations.en.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
translations.id.indonesian: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

arabic: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ فُرُشٍۭ بَطَآئِنُهَا مِنْ إِسْتَبْرَقٍۢ ۚ وَجَنَى ٱلْجَنَّتَيْنِ دَانٍۢ
transliteration: Muttaki'eena 'alaa furushim bataaa'inuhaa min istabraq; wajanal jannataini daan

translations.en.sahih: [They are] reclining on beds whose linings are of silk brocade, and the fruit of the two gardens is hanging low.
translations.en.pickthall: Reclining upon couches lined with silk brocade, the fruit of both the gardens near to hand.
translations.en.yusufali: They will recline on Carpets, whose inner linings will be of rich brocade: the Fruit of the Gardens will be near (and easy of reach).
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka bertelekan di atas permadani yang sebelah dalamnya dari sutera. Dan buah-buahan di kedua surga itu dapat (dipetik) dari dekat.

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.en.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
translations.en.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
translations.id.indonesian: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

arabic: فِيهِنَّ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌۭ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّۭ
transliteration: Feehinna qaasiratut tarfi lam yatmishunna insun qablahum wa laa jaaann

translations.en.sahih: In them are women limiting [their] glances, untouched before them by man or jinni -
translations.en.pickthall: Therein are those of modest gaze, whom neither man nor jinni will have touched before them.
translations.en.yusufali: In them will be (Maidens), chaste, restraining their glances, whom no man or Jinn before them has touched;-
translations.id.indonesian: Di dalam surga itu ada bidadari-bidadari yang sopan menundukkan pandangannya, tidak pernah disentuh oleh manusia sebelum mereka (penghuni-penghuni surga yang menjadi suami mereka), dan tidak pula oleh jin.

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
translations.en.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
translations.en.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?-
translations.id.indonesian: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

translations.en.sahih: As if they were rubies and coral.
translations.en.pickthall: (In beauty) like the jacynth and the coral-stone.
translations.en.yusufali: Like unto Rubies and coral.
translations.id.indonesian: Seakan-akan bidadari itu permata yakut dan marjan.

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.en.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
translations.en.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
translations.id.indonesian: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

translations.en.sahih: Is the reward for good [anything] but good?
translations.en.pickthall: Is the reward of goodness aught save goodness?
translations.en.yusufali: Is there any Reward for Good - other than Good?
translations.id.indonesian: Tidak ada balasan kebaikan kecuali kebaikan (pula).

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.en.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
translations.en.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
translations.id.indonesian: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

translations.en.sahih: And below them both [in excellence] are two [other] gardens -
translations.en.pickthall: And beside them are two other gardens,
translations.en.yusufali: And besides these two, there are two other Gardens,-
translations.id.indonesian: Dan selain dari dua surga itu ada dua surga lagi

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
translations.en.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
translations.en.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?-
translations.id.indonesian: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

translations.en.sahih: Dark green [in color].
translations.en.pickthall: Dark green with foliage.
translations.en.yusufali: Dark-green in colour (from plentiful watering).
translations.id.indonesian: Kedua surga itu (kelihatan) hijau tua warnanya.

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.en.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
translations.en.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
translations.id.indonesian: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

translations.en.sahih: In both of them are two springs, spouting.
translations.en.pickthall: Wherein are two abundant springs.
translations.en.yusufali: In them (each) will be two Springs pouring forth water in continuous abundance:
translations.id.indonesian: Di dalam kedua surga itu ada dua buah mata air yang memancar.

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.en.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
translations.en.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
translations.id.indonesian: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

transliteration: Feehimaa faakihatunw wa nakhlunw wa rummaan

translations.en.sahih: In both of them are fruit and palm trees and pomegranates.
translations.en.pickthall: Wherein is fruit, the date-palm and pomegranate.
translations.en.yusufali: In them will be Fruits, and dates and pomegranates:
translations.id.indonesian: Di dalam keduanya (ada macam-macam) buah-buahan dan kurma serta delima.

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.en.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
translations.en.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
translations.id.indonesian: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

translations.en.sahih: In them are good and beautiful women -
translations.en.pickthall: Wherein (are found) the good and beautiful -
translations.en.yusufali: In them will be fair (Companions), good, beautiful;-
translations.id.indonesian: Di dalam surga itu ada bidadari-bidadari yang baik-baik lagi cantik-cantik.

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
translations.en.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny? -
translations.en.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?-
translations.id.indonesian: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

translations.en.sahih: Fair ones reserved in pavilions -
translations.en.pickthall: Fair ones, close-guarded in pavilions -
translations.en.yusufali: Companions restrained (as to their glances), in (goodly) pavilions;-
translations.id.indonesian: (Bidadari-bidadari) yang jelita, putih bersih, dipingit dalam rumah.

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
translations.en.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny? -
translations.en.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?-
translations.id.indonesian: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

arabic: لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌۭ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّۭ
transliteration: Lam yatmis hunna insun qablahum wa laa jaaann

translations.en.sahih: Untouched before them by man or jinni -
translations.en.pickthall: Whom neither man nor jinni will have touched before them -
translations.en.yusufali: Whom no man or Jinn before them has touched;-
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka tidak pernah disentuh oleh manusia sebelum mereka (penghuni-penghuni surga yang menjadi suami mereka), dan tidak pula oleh jin.

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
translations.en.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
translations.en.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?-
translations.id.indonesian: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

arabic: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ رَفْرَفٍ خُضْرٍۢ وَعَبْقَرِىٍّ حِسَانٍۢ

translations.en.sahih: Reclining on green cushions and beautiful fine carpets.
translations.en.pickthall: Reclining on green cushions and fair carpets.
translations.en.yusufali: Reclining on green Cushions and rich Carpets of beauty.
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka bertelekan pada bantal-bantal yang hijau dan permadani-permadani yang indah.

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.en.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
translations.en.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
translations.id.indonesian: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

arabic: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱسْمُ رَبِّكَ ذِى ٱلْجَلَٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ

translations.en.sahih: Blessed is the name of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.
translations.en.pickthall: Blessed be the name of thy Lord, Mighty and glorious!
translations.en.yusufali: Blessed be the name of thy Lord, full of Majesty, Bounty and Honour.
translations.id.indonesian: Maha Agung nama Tuhanmu Yang Mempunyai Kebesaran dan Karunia.
